agent-task-queue.reason: Needs python3Packages.fastmcp, marked broken in nixos-unstable since mcp 2.x; nixos-nvme's home-manager MCP config failed to evaluate.

aider-chat.reason: Needs python3Packages.posthog, marked broken in nixos-unstable since mcp 2.x; mac-mini's persona-runtime failed to evaluate, which held back the fleet's whole lock update.

open-webui.reason: Needs python3Packages.chromadb, which needs posthog, marked broken in nixos-unstable since mcp 2.x; the container-factory's open-webui container failed to evaluate.

oterm.reason: Needs python3Packages.fastmcp, marked broken in nixos-unstable since mcp 2.x; nix-devshells' ai shell failed to evaluate.

qdrant.reason: rustc's stdarch and nixpkgs' LLVM disagree on an AVX-512 VNNI intrinsic (vpdpbusd), so qdrant's quantization crate fails to compile; this source patch from NixOS/nixpkgs#553347 disables those code paths. Ends once nixpkgs' qdrant builds again (rustc on LLVM 23, NixOS/nixpkgs#578990, plus a zstd input on staging-next). Held on stable (1.17.1) from 2026-10-13 until this fix on 2026-11-01.
